components.name: Status mark
components.description: Status as shape, then word in its -ink token, then color.
components.html: Quá hạn 5 ngày
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-shape { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: var(--overdue, oklch(56% 0.19 28)); } .ds-status-word { color: var(--overdue-ink, oklch(48% 0.17 28)); }

narrative.overview: Esta looks like a well-kept paper ledger set beside a piece of Vietnamese lacquerware (sơn mài). Warm paper, deep ink, one restrained lacquer red, generous margins. Type, rule lines and whitespace carry the structure that boxes and shadows carry in a SaaS dashboard. The reference is a private bank statement.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on paper on most screens. One accent, used rarely.
A serif for figures and page titles, a sans for everything else.
Hairline rules instead of cards. No card inside a card, no shadow stacks.
Status as shape plus word plus color.
Light and dark themes from one token source, chosen per member and rendered by the server.

rules.name: The Proven Pair Rule
rules.body: Every foreground and background pair the UI draws is listed in text-pairs.ts and measured by pnpm contrast:check in both themes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lacquer appears on a small fraction of any screen. Primary buttons are ink, not accent.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Amounts use the figure face with the figures utility and sit right-aligned in tables.

rules.name: The Full Coverage Rule
rules.body: pnpm glyphs:check reads every shipped font file at every weight in typefaces and fails on any miss.

rules.name: The Leading Rule
rules.body: Line height stays at 1.3 or more, so Vietnamese stacked marks clear the line above.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: Never Inter, Arial, Roboto or a system face as the identity face, and never a font CDN.

dos: Do set every color from a token (bg-paper, text-ink, var(--due-ink)), and add a new pairing to text-pairs.ts before it ships.
Do put amounts in Source Serif 4 with figures, right-aligned.
Do show status as shape, word in its -ink token, then color.
Do read the theme from the esta_theme cookie on the server, so the first byte is already in the right theme.
Do run pnpm tokens:build after editing tokens.ts and commit the generated tokens.css.
donts: Don't use pure black, pure white, gradients, glass or neon.
Don't nest cards, stack shadows, or put icon tiles above headings.
Don't set gray text on a colored background, or a status word in its shape color.
Don't use more than one accent, or lacquer as a status.
Don't use uppercase letter-spaced labels, centered body text, hover-only actions, or icon-only buttons on mobile.
Don't use emoji, sparkle or magic-wand icons for the assistant.
